verdict.rationale: Deel's marketing pages claim 'automated compliance' and payroll processing across 150+ countries, implying broad tax/compliance handling, but no evidence specifically addresses U.S. multi-state payroll registrations or per-state withholding mechanics. Missing for 10: documentation on state-specific tax registration setup, per-state withholding calculation details, and any hands-on/independent verification of multi-state payroll accuracy.
